title: Cut CI and agent-loop wall time: complete main runs, restore caches per shard, cache geiger and Kani
goal: Measured on the last 70 Test runs: no main run completed (34 cancelled; Kani sat queued on the retired ubuntu-20.04 runner, cancel-in-progress cancelled the rest), the six matrix shards shared one 402 MB rust-cache key so root-cli rebuilt for 12 min while its tests ran 40 s, cargo-geiger recompiled on every push (5-7 min, the branch critical path), and workflow check made four sequential 3 s fetches. Fix each, and pin the invariants with a regression test.
